description: Load source records and normalized objects first, then promotion decisions, index records, and review tickets.
Promotion decisions are scoring and review signals; they do not directly publish active components without curator or policy approval.
Unresolved source or object references should not block load; nullable foreign keys preserve operational flow while original ids remain in index text and metadata.
Every promotion decision should produce at least one quality index record so review queues and search can rank candidates by score and risk.
Non-promoted or risky decisions should emit review tickets with reason, status, priority signal, and evidence metadata.
Planning emits CSV and SQL only; actual psql execution is a separate operator or worker step.
